purpose: Model maintained Sales-relevant data as typed entities that can be traversed by people and AI: what the object is, where it is valid, which fields matter, who consumes it, what it overrides or refines, and how to prove a failure.

entity_classes.meaning: Long-lived business object maintained independently of a sales document.
A maintained relationship between master objects, often customer/product or customer/customer.
Validity-based master data evaluated by a configured condition technique.
Reusable text or communication content copied or determined into business documents.
Master data owned outside core Sales but consumed by Sales or delivery logic.
Enterprise structure that scopes data and rules; intentionally not labelled classic master data.

document_projection_contract.purpose: Connect maintained data and determination mechanisms to runtime sales, delivery and billing document nodes without misclassifying the documents as master data.

anti_patterns: Treating every BP or product field as equally important to Sales.
Calling sales organization, distribution channel, division, plant, or company code master data just because they appear on a master-data screen.
Debugging the document before identifying the maintained source, scope, partner role, validity, and precedence.
Conflating condition records with the condition technique configuration that decides how records are searched.
Assuming a value visible in a sales document still belongs to master data after it has been copied or determined.
Assuming sold-to party owns every customer-derived field; ship-to, bill-to and payer may supply different downstream context.
Using classic tables or transactions as if they were universal public-cloud integration contracts.
